title: Identity Crisis

nodes.speaker: John Doe
nodes.text: Damn! Am I glad to see you!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Damn! Am I glad to see you!
Another day, another dream.

nodes.speaker: John Doe
nodes.text: Trying my hand at real estate and could use some input.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Trying my hand at real estate and could use some input.

nodes.speaker: John Doe
nodes.text: Yeah! What else can reflect a multitude of personalities other than a multitude of, um, properties? Right? I think I'm right.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah! What else can reflect a multitude of personalities other than a multitude of, um, properties? Right? I think I'm right.

nodes.speaker: John Doe
nodes.text: Of course I'm right! You don't travel through time without gaining a little bit of know-how!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course I'm right! You don't travel through time without gaining a little bit of know-how!

nodes.speaker: John Doe
nodes.text: Oh, go break an android leg! I know what I'm doing. I think. You don't travel through time without gaining a little bit of know-how!

nodes.speaker: John Doe
nodes.text: A little more than you! HA! Wait, new idea forming here. Yup, okay, we're gonna do a trial run and you're gonna be the one to do it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A little more than you! HA! Wait, new idea forming here. Yup, okay, we're gonna do a trial run and you're gonna be the one to do it.

nodes.speaker: John Doe
nodes.text: It's simple, really. Since I've been stuck in a different time and then sequestered in a CorpSec lab while they do their Seccy Seccy things to me, you're my window into this period.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's simple, really. Since I've been stuck in a different time and then sequestered in a CorpSec lab while they do their Seccy Seccy things to me, you're my window into this period.

nodes.speaker: John Doe
nodes.text: I have a place for you to stage. Garnish it up like your favorite cocktail that best reflects Nivalis and I'll take it from there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have a place for you to stage. Garnish it up like your favorite cocktail that best reflects Nivalis and I'll take it from there.

nodes.speaker: John Doe
nodes.text: It's like a jumping off point. Once I get this down, I'll be able to tweak and bend and break it according to every time period I was sent to.... ALLLLL OFFFFF THEMMMMM.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's like a jumping off point. Once I get this down, I'll be able to tweak and bend and break it according to every time period I was sent to.... ALLLLL OFFFFF THEMMMMM.

nodes.speaker: John Doe
nodes.text: Awesome! You go get started while I make like my pops and disappear!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Awesome! You go get started while I make like my pops and disappear!

nodes.text: What happened with your... identity crisis?

nodes.text: How am I going to do that?
